events.label: Post-apocalyptic underground; prisoners experimented on
events.description: After a war has poisoned the surface of the Earth, survivors live in underground galleries beneath Paris, where prisoners are chosen for strange experiments.

events.label: Man fixated on childhood pier image — woman's face
events.description: One prisoner is chosen because of the image that has haunted him since childhood: a man dying on a pier at Orly airport, and a woman's face he cannot forget.

events.label: Scientists send him to past via memory anchor
events.description: The experimenters realise a strong memory can anchor a living mind in the past, and they begin sending the man back to the moment his obsession was born.

events.label: Meets the woman repeatedly in the past
events.description: In the past he meets the woman from the image, again and again, walking the same sunny Paris she lived in.

events.label: Relationship forms across visits
events.description: Visit by visit the two fall in love across a gap he cannot explain to her - a man with no future courting a woman in the past.

events.label: Sent to far future; offered escape
events.description: The scientists push him further, to the far future - where the people there, knowing his story, offer him a place among them.

events.label: Chooses return to the pier / woman over future exile
events.description: He refuses the future and asks instead to be sent back to the pier - to the woman, to the moment he has loved all his life.

events.label: Returns to Orly pier of the memory
events.description: He arrives on the Orly pier of his memory, walking toward the woman waiting at the end of it.

events.label: Killed on the pier — childhood memory was his own death
events.description: As he reaches her, an agent of the underground who followed him through time shoots him dead - the image that defined his life was his own death all along.

events.label: Child witness is the same man seeing his future death
events.description: The boy who witnessed the man's death on the pier, and carried the woman's face through his life, was the dying man himself as a child.

events.label: Narrative told almost entirely in still photographs
events.description: The story is told almost entirely in still photographs, with only one fleeting moment of live motion - a woman waking in bed.

events.label: Memory that enables travel is the death it causes
events.description: The loop closes on itself: the memory that let him travel back is the death that travel leads him to.

events.label: Child sees woman and death at Orly
events.description: A child stands at Orly and sees a man die and a woman cry out - the image that will shape a life.

events.label: WWIII underground experiments
events.description: The Third World War, and the underground experiments that followed it.

events.label: Prisoner sent to past via memory
events.description: The prisoner sent into the past on the anchor of his own memory.

events.label: Meets woman in past
events.description: The meetings with the woman in the past, scene by still scene.

events.label: Visit future beings
events.description: The visit to the people of the far future, and their offer.

events.label: Return to pier moment
events.description: The return to the pier, chosen over sanctuary in the future.

events.label: He is the dying man he saw
events.description: He is the dying man he has always remembered seeing.

events.label: Memory was own death
events.description: The memory was his own death - the beginning and the end of the same image.

ruleEffects.effect: Choosing the pier fulfills the death that made the experiment possible
Pier memory has no origin outside the death loop

outcome.summary: Pure fatalism: the childhood pier memory is the man's own assassination; 12 Monkeys ancestor.
